candidates.title: Advantages of the mean absolute error (MAE) over the root mean square error (RMSE) in assessing average model performance
candidates.reason: Willmott and Matsuura (2005) is the seminal paper formalizing and advocating for Mean Absolute Error (MAE) as the standard, unambiguous metric for evaluating average model performance and prediction residuals, widely cited when defining MAE alongside squared-error metrics.
